title: Monthly equity, index and cash-settled currency options expiration — January 2028 (the Friday of a four-session expiration week, inside the January 2028 FOMC blackout)
source: EST: rule-derived, and validated against the OCC's own calendar on the row class whose title IS this event's title. optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), parsed BY LEGEND GUID rather than by eye: class 6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B ('Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date') holds 36 rows spanning 2025-01-17 -> 2027-12-17 and stops 13 months short of this date. Against those rows the third-Friday rule reproduces 33 of 36, all three misses Friday-holiday displacements (Good Friday 2025-04-18 -> 04-17; Juneteenth 2026-06-19 -> 06-18; Juneteenth observed 2027-06-18 -> 06-17). JANUARY 2028 CAN CARRY NO SUCH DISPLACEMENT: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes) puts the month's ONLY closure on Monday 2028-01-17 (MLK), with no New Year's observance at all under the footnote 'Because the holiday falls on Saturday, January 1, 2028, no New Year's Day holiday is observed' — and a Monday closure cannot move a Friday expiration. The date itself is plain arithmetic: 2028-01-01 is a Saturday, so January 2028's Fridays are the 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th. STAYS ESTIMATE, and the limit is stated precisely rather than as 'no primary was read': the OCC file ends 13 months early, and all three of its Januaries (2025-01-17, 2026-01-16, 2027-01-15) are the OPPOSITE configuration to 2028 — MLK three days AFTER the expiration in every one — so the fetched primary contains zero instances of this event's shape. Promotion requires an OCC or exchange primary that reaches 2028, never a recomputation of the rule. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Canonical file written by the opex-2028-01-21 initial-research session (2026-09-09) after reading the sole proposal, proposals/opex-2028-01-21.from-mlk-market-closure-2028-01-17.json, whose finding it confirms and whose source class it improves on (that proposal validated against the 15AA2B9D 'A.M. settled index options cease trading' proxy class; this file reads the expiration-date class itself). Impact medium per the class rule: 2028's quarterly triple witchings are March, June, September and December, so January is an ordinary monthly and files alongside every other ordinary opex-* entry. TWO STRUCTURAL FEATURES, both measured rather than asserted, neither tradeable. (1) MLK 2028-01-17 is this expiration MINUS FOUR, so the Monday of expiration week is shut and the week runs four sessions (01-18, 01-19, 01-20, 01-21) — the 22/53 (41.5%) minority configuration computed 1998-2050 by the proposing lane and reproduced here. The consequence for measurement is the finding this event owns: the pre-window then spans 8 calendar days against a clean 7 while the post-window stays clean, which is NOT the mirror of the holiday-after geometry the shelf has measured (there the post-window spans 10 against a clean 7). One perturbation is three times the other, on the opposite side. Measured over 296 expirations 2002-2026 on QQQ and SPY by scripts/research/expiration-window-geometry.mjs, added in this same PR: the holiday-after class inflates the house five-session ratio at Mann-Whitney P = 0.0010 / 0.0001, while THIS class is indistinguishable from a clean window (P = 0.8841 / 0.5138). (2) The whole four-session week sits inside the FOMC communications blackout 2028-01-15 -> 2028-01-27 (fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15, estimate), where the January 2027 counterpart opened one day after that year's expiration. Frequency now computed from the Fed Board's own published calendars, answering the question the mlk-market-closure-2028-01-17 ledger explicitly left open: 58 of 408 expirations 1994-2027 fall inside a blackout (14.2%), ordinary monthlies 19/272 (7.0%), January 3/34 (8.8%) — and all three January instances (2011, 2012, 2022) are also four-session-week years, making 2028-01-21 the fourth instance of the exact double configuration since 1994. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty; a re-grep of trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md on a widened pattern (opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|third friday|LEAPS|pin|blackout|shortened week) returns four hits, all four substring false positives on 'pin' inside gapping/flipping/overlapping/dropping — zero real. Estimate; estimates widen caution and license no entry.
